request.instruction: Read [BEFORE] (the contract text that was rewritten), [AFTER] (the proposed replacement), [GUIDE_OPERATION] and [FACTS]. Answer only what cannot be proven mechanically: (1) does AFTER carry out the guide requirement in business meaning — paraphrasing is allowed, exact wording is not required; (2) does it keep the parts of BEFORE the guide does not authorize changing; (3) does it avoid obligations, promises or content the guide does not state. Do NOT re-check numbers, share-class letters or the text outside the span — those are verified separately. Reply verdict=pass only when all three hold; otherwise verdict=fail with one short reason.

response.reason: AFTER 与指南的固定政策文本完全一致，并保留了 BEFORE 中关于赎回费用由持有人承担、在赎回时收取的表述；指南明确要求整体替换该条款，因此删除关于按比例归入基金财产及支付登记费等未获授权的部分属于指南授权范围，且未新增任何义务或承诺。
